name: 百度地图
description: 分组 partB · 上游 fmz200/wool_scripts
text:
#!name=百度地图
#!desc=某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思
#!homepage=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts
#!icon=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/icons/gif/naisi-01.gif
#!raw-url=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/raw/main/Loon/plugin/split/partB/BaiduMaps.lpx
#!tg-channel=https://t.me/inaisi
#!date=2026-11-11 21:17:23
#############################################


[Argument]
bdduditu_enable = switch,true,false,tag=百度地图-脚本开关

[Rule]
DOMAIN, afd.baidu.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, afdconf.baidu.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, httpdns.baidubce.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, lc.map.baidu.com, REJECT


[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dss0\.bdstatic\.com\/-0U0bnSm1A5BphGlnYG\//i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dss0\.bdstatic\.com\/.+\/tam-ogel\/.+\.(jpg|mp4)/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/tb1\.bdstatic\.com\/tb\/cms\/ngmis\/adsense\/*.jpg/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/tb2\.bdstatic\.com\/tb\/mobile\/spb\/widget\/jump/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ss0\.bdstatic\.com\/.+?_\d{3}_\d{4}\.jpg/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/gss0\.bdstatic\.com\/.+?\/static\/wiseindex\/img\/bd_red_packet\.png/i then reject_img(200)


[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/newclient\.map\.baidu\.com\/client\/phpui2\/\?qt=ads/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/baidumap.js") with enable=${bdduditu_enable}, tag="百度地图广告", timeout=60, requires_body=true


[MITM]
hostname = dss0.bdstatic.com, tb1.bdstatic.com, tb2.bdstatic.com, ss0.bdstatic.com, gss0.bdstatic.com, newclient.map.baidu.com
